held_out_likelihood.training_amplitude_weight: Gaussian profile likelihood normalized on nonnegative amplitudes with explicit flat amplitude measure
held_out_likelihood.predictive_distribution_approximation: Moment-matched mean/covariance of truncated amplitude; quadratic is not a calibrated Gaussian p-value near the boundary
held_out_likelihood.scope: Conditional group prediction under fixed geometry, wavelength, instrumental response and stationary noise; no independent author PIXTAB pooling or elemental abundance posterior.
